# [Summary AI returns 500 for intelligent/summary endpoint on OpenReplay Cloud](https://forum.openreplay.com/t/summary-ai-returns-500-for-intelligent-summary-endpoint-on-openreplay-cloud/563)


[Issues & Bugs](https://forum.openreplay.com/c/issues/5)


[helloword222](https://forum.openreplay.com/u/helloword222)


April 13, 2026, 4:44pm 1


Hi team,


I’m using OpenReplay Cloud and session replay itself works correctly, but the AI Summary panel
keeps loading forever.


I checked the network request and found the Summary AI endpoint returns HTTP 500.


Details:


- project_id: XXX3
- session_id: XXXXXXXXXXXXXX
- endpoint:[https://api.openreplay.com/XXX3/sessions/3XXXXX/intelligent/summary](https://api.openreplay.com/XXX3/sessions/3XXXXX/intelligent/summary)
- observed behavior: replay works, but AI Summary stays in loading skeleton state
- network result: HTTP 500
- timestamp: 2026-04-10


Notes:


- Session replay data is available and can be played normally
- The issue seems isolated to the AI summary generation step


Could you please help check whether this is a backend issue, entitlement issue, or AI pipeline
failure for this project/session?


Thanks.
